description: This file contains the PcbMoveTool class which provides functionality to read, manipulate, and write PCB layout data represented as PcbNode objects. It includes methods for moving various graphical elements within a PCB design, such as lines, circles, arcs, text, zones, segments, vias, and modules, by specified (dx, dy) offsets.

classes.name: PcbMoveTool
classes.description: A utility class for moving PCB layout elements within a design file based on specified coordinate offsets.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point to the tool; parses command-line arguments, reads the source PCB file, moves its contents by specified offsets, and writes the result to a destination file.

methods.name: readAndMove
methods.description: Reads a PCB file and moves all its elements by specified x and y offsets, returning the modified PcbNode.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Performs the movement operation on various components within the PCB node, adjusting positions of lines, arcs, circles, texts, zones, segments, vias, and modules.

methods.name: movePts
methods.description: Moves a list of points within a polygon or filled polygon by specified offsets.

methods.name: moveStartEnd
methods.description: Moves start and end points of segments or lines by specified offsets.

methods.name: moveAt
methods.description: Moves the 'at' coordinate of a PCB component.

methods.name: moveCoordinatesInFirstChildren
methods.description: Moves the coordinates within the first child node of a given PcbNode.

methods.name: moveCoordinates
methods.description: Adjusts the x and y coordinates within a PcbNode by specified offsets at a given index.
